Square Enix responds to Kingdom Hearts Collection AI controversy two months after players called it out

Kingdom Hearts publisher and developer, Square Enix, has denied claims that it used AI-generated content to promote the yet-to-be-released Kingdom Hearts Collection 1-3. Fans first accused the company of using AI back in early June, and now - some two months after the initial accusations - Square Enix has responded.

Marvel Tokon will be released unto the world by the terrible trio of Marvel, Sony, and Arc System Works later this week. author: Eurogamer
text:
Memory chip maker Samsung says the component shortage will continue to get worse in 2027, while earning a pretty penny from it

Samsung, one of the largest manufacturers of memory and storage in the world, has delivered bad news for anyone hoping the global component shortages will ease up soon. Samsung, which is responsible for about a third of the global memory supply, revealed in an earnings call that it expects the crisis to continue getting worse into next year.
